title: Cigar-shaped object in distress seen by farmers over Varginha
summary: James Fox tells of Cigar-shaped object in distress seen by farmers over Varginha, about January 1996 at Varginha, Brazil, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It was January 1996, probably the 13th, and there are a number of witnesses to a cylindrical shaped object, rather large, the size of a little bigger than a school bus.

plain: James Fox, who covered the case in a documentary called Moment of Contact, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that around 13 January 1996, several farmers near Varginha, a town in Brazil, saw a large object shaped like a cylinder or cigar, a bit bigger than a school bus. He passes on what witnesses told him, which is that the object seemed to be in trouble. People tell this because it may be the start of the Varginha events, and another farmer says he saw an object come down on his land.
